ana.m: Quick cross-team check — we need to lock down the audit-log ingest + KMS integration before the ISO milestone on 2026-04-15. Who owns the end-to-end flow (producer -> ingest -> encrypted S3 -> index)? I think infra owns the key material + HSM attestation, infra+ingest own the pipeline, and compliance owns retention + proofs. Confirm?

mike_r: I picked up the ingest PR (https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/482). Main blocker is decryption test vectors; need access to the KMS test key in staging. ETA for review: EOD Thu.

prashant: @mike_r I can enable the staging key but need a list of specific principals (service accounts) that require decrypt. Share the names here and I'll grant them for the window. Also we should capture a signed attestation from HSM during key import.

jess: Compliance requirement: logs must show key usage events (encrypt/decrypt/rotate) with user/principal, timestamp, and operation. Retention: 1 year for audit logs, 7 years for key-change metadata. Also need a queryable index for a SOC2 auditor demo.

darcy: infra side: Owner for HSM/KMS setup = darcy (I auto-assigned in the infra board). I'll run the KMS import on 3/28 and produce the attestation blob. For RBAC, we'll need these service accounts: sb-ingest, sb-indexer, sb-console. Confirm if any others.

mike_r: Adding sb-archive (for cold storage) to the list. PR updated with test principal list.

prashant: Thanks. I'll create a short script to rotate the test key and emit the attestation to S3. Suggestion: use envelope encryption on producer side, then server-side decrypt for indexing.

jess: For the auditor demo, we need a canned query. Example SQL against our audit index:

```sql
SELECT count(*) AS usages, principal
FROM audit_logs
WHERE event_type IN ('kms.encrypt', 'kms.decrypt', 'kms.rotate')
  AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY principal
ORDER BY usages DESC;
```

jess: That should surface key usage. Also need a signed timeline of rotations: timestamps + attestation reference.

darcy: Will push attestation metadata to s3://redwood-audit/hsm-attestations/2026-03-28.json and add lifecycle to keep 7y. I'll also add a small indexer job to copy metadata to the audit index.

mike_r: One more ask: can security grant read-only access to the audit index for compliance-bot? We can then auto-generate the demo snapshot.

compliance-bot: Auto-checklist update: 
- KMS/HSM attestation planned (owner: darcy) :white_check_mark_expected:
- Audit-log schema includes key events (owner: jess) :in_progress:
- Retention policies defined (owner: darcy) :in_progress:
- Staging key granted to principals (owner: prashant) :todo:
- Demo query + snapshot (owner: mike_r + compliance) :todo:

prashant: I granted staging decrypt to sb-ingest, sb-indexer, sb-archive. Run your tests and ping me if anything else pops up.

mike_r: Ran the decryption test, all green except CI uses an older artifact; I opened a small fix in the PR. After merge I'll schedule a short canary run against staging.

ana.m: (typo — should be ana.m) small note: pls record decision doc about envelope vs server decrypt. That decision needs to go in the SOC2 evidence repo.

jess: I'll draft the decision doc and link in the ticket. Template: problem, options, chosen approach, security tradeoffs, audit commands.

darcy: Also adding a rollback playbook for key rotation in case index fails. Will share draft before EOD Wed.

mike_r: Deploy bot: release/ingest v1.12 -> staging deployed by ci-bot at 1792000456 (see pipeline) :rocket:

sre-bot: Canary run scheduled at 1792000600 for ingest pipeline (10 minute window). Monitoring alerts will post here.

mike_r: Canary completed, no errors. Moving to scheduled run for broader sample.

jess: Action items summary:
- darcy: HSM attestation file + retention policy (due 2026-03-28)
- prashant: grant staging principals (done), rotate test key and push attestation (due 2026-03-28)
- mike_r: finalize PR, run canary, capture demo snapshot (due 2026-03-30)
- jess: draft decision doc + demo query (due 2026-03-29)
- compliance-bot: update checklist when artifacts land

ana.m: :thumbsup: tagging owners in project board. If anyone hits blockers, put it in the thread and CC eng-oncall.

darcy: I'll post the attestation S3 link when ready.

mike_r: after demo snapshot is captured I'll attach it to the SOC2 ticket and ping compliance.

prashant: sounds good. Closing loop for now.

compliance-bot: Reminder: audit window for fieldwork starts 2026-04-10. Make sure artifacts are in the evidence bucket by 2026-04-05 to give reviewers time.

ana.m: noted. Thanks all.
